collection_custom_properties.heine_facade_revision: R2, 2026-10-27: replaced R1 five-pane stacks with seven tall narrow vertical glazing slots, broad stone spandrels and restrained rails; rebuilt entrance as a four-arch full-height stone arcade. GIS shell and local origin preserved.
collection_custom_properties.heine_facade_uncertainty: Seven-bay rhythm, tall paired glazing and substantial four-arch portal follow one dated oblique photograph. Exact dimensions, hidden elevations, absolute height and interior room layouts remain estimated or schematic.
collection_custom_properties.heine_entry_arcade_r2: Four extruded stone arches; 17.2 m overall width, 7.35 m top, positioned at the existing evidence-derived entry center. Dimensions are visual estimates from the 2023 oblique photograph.
